infobox.usage: Unlocks the inner door at the security post of the crane yard on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Security post key (Security) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens the security post located across from the gas station in the Customs terminal industrial area.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: The inner door at the security post of the crane yard on Customs.
